projects.title: AI-Powered Customer Support Platform
projects.problem: A high volume of repetitive tickets slowed response times and hurt customer satisfaction.
projects.solution: An AI-first support platform with intelligent ticket routing, automated answers to common queries and AI-assisted agent suggestions.

projects.title: Multi-Tenant E-Commerce Marketplace
projects.problem: The client needed a scalable marketplace for hundreds of vendors, with complex inventory, commission and payout logic.
projects.solution: Vendor dashboards, automated commission calculations, real-time inventory sync and integrated payments.
projects.outcome: A marketplace platform built for hundreds of vendors.

projects.title: Manufacturing IoT Dashboard
projects.problem: No real-time visibility into equipment performance was causing unplanned downtime.
projects.solution: An IoT analytics platform ingesting sensor data from 200+ machines, with predictive maintenance alerts, OEE tracking and custom dashboards.

projects.title: Healthcare Patient Portal
projects.problem: A clinic network needed a secure, HIPAA-compliant portal for appointments, records, telehealth and messaging.
projects.solution: Appointment scheduling, secure messaging, telehealth integration, prescription management and audit logging.
projects.outcome: A secure, compliant patient experience across the clinic network.

projects.title: FinTech Lending Platform
projects.problem: A startup needed a compliant lending platform with KYC/AML, credit scoring and automated underwriting.
projects.solution: Identity verification, ML-based credit scoring, document processing and bank-grade security.

projects.title: EdTech Adaptive Learning Platform
projects.problem: An EdTech company needed an AI engine to personalize learning paths for 100K+ students.
projects.solution: Knowledge tracing, content recommendations, real-time analytics and a mobile-first responsive design.

projects.title: Logistics Route Optimization Engine
projects.problem: A regional carrier with 500+ vehicles needed AI-driven route optimization to cut fuel costs and improve on-time delivery.
projects.solution: A route engine built on OR-Tools and custom heuristics, integrated with telematics and dispatch systems.

projects.title: Professional Services Practice Management
projects.problem: A consulting firm needed integrated practice management across resource planning, proposals, time tracking and utilization.
projects.solution: One platform replacing five tools, with resource allocation, automated proposal generation and utilization dashboards.
